commit_message:
[Build] Stop CMake riscv64 defaults from clobbering test cpu-features (#24866)

platform cmake defaults were appending
--iree-llvmcpu-target-cpu-features= after test variants, so the default
overwrote +xsmtvdot / VLEN. this prevents the override of an existing
cpu-features flag; prepend missing +m,+a,+f,+d,+c. and strips those from
generator --requirements=.

Towards: #24859

---------

Signed-off-by: Terence <terrencemahlatini@gmail.com>
Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commit_message:
Integrate LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@a98f7ed68e (#24963)

LLVM staging branch: `sm-iree-integrates/llvm-20260925`

Adds a cherry-pick of llvm/llvm-project#226903 to support
minimumnumf/maximumnumf semantics. The new reduction kinds were
introduced in llvm/llvm-project@8306f777. QNaN was chosen as an identity
arg for the new kinds so as to propagate signalling NaNs correctly. As
per the LLVM LangRef:

> Return the other argument if one of the arguments is NaN.


(https://llvm.org/docs/LangRef.html#floating-point-min-max-intrinsics-comparison)

Additionally:
- Update compiler and end-to-end TOSA tests for the strict property
assembly format (llvm/llvm-project@b9da7a34)
- Redeclare LLVM libxml2 and xz Bazel dependencies
(llvm/llvm-project@bd0da2bf7dae, llvm/llvm-project@4989b3b0)
- Regenerate API exports

Assisted-by: Codex

Signed-off-by: Artem Gindinson <gindinson@roofline.ai>
name: setup / setup

LLVM staging branch: `sm-iree-integrates/llvm-20260925`

Adds a cherry-pick of llvm/llvm-project#226903 to support
minimumnumf/maximumnumf semantics. The new reduction kinds were
introduced in llvm/llvm-project@8306f777. QNaN was chosen as an identity
arg for the new kinds so as to propagate signalling NaNs correctly. As
per the LLVM LangRef:

> Return the other argument if one of the arguments is NaN.


(https://llvm.org/docs/LangRef.html#floating-point-min-max-intrinsics-comparison)

Additionally:
- Update compiler and end-to-end TOSA tests for the strict property
assembly format (llvm/llvm-project@b9da7a34)
- Redeclare LLVM libxml2 and xz Bazel dependencies
(llvm/llvm-project@bd0da2bf7dae, llvm/llvm-project@4989b3b0)
- Regenerate API exports

Assisted-by: Codex

Signed-off-by: Artem Gindinson <gindinson@roofline.ai>
name: Test Torch / test_torch_ops :: amdgpu_hip_gfx1100_O3

commit_message:
[Stream] Fix O(N²) compile-time scaling in partitionRegionConcurrency (#24958)

When analyzing execution regions where many operations share a common
resource operand, `partitionRegionConcurrencyReference` previously
invoked `tiedOp.hasAnyTiedUses(operand)` inside the `operand.getUsers()`
loop. Because checking whether an operand has tied uses involves
scanning its use sites, repeating this check inside the loop caused
quadratic $O(N^2)$ traversal over the users of that operand.

This change hoists the check out of the loop using the static helper
`IREE::Util::TiedOpInterface::hasAnyTiedUses(operand)` as an early exit.
Inside the loop, it now only checks whether the candidate user
implements `TiedOpInterface`. This eliminates redundant scans and
resolves the compiler performance bottleneck while preserving existing
partitioning semantics.

Fixes #24928

  Signed-off-by: @isa-Lai 
  Assisted-by:  Gemini CLI

Signed-off-by: isa-lai <isabellai1004@gmail.com>
name: linux_x64_gcc

commit_message:
[Stream] Fix O(N²) compile-time scaling in partitionRegionConcurrency (#24958)

When analyzing execution regions where many operations share a common
resource operand, `partitionRegionConcurrencyReference` previously
invoked `tiedOp.hasAnyTiedUses(operand)` inside the `operand.getUsers()`
loop. Because checking whether an operand has tied uses involves
scanning its use sites, repeating this check inside the loop caused
quadratic $O(N^2)$ traversal over the users of that operand.

This change hoists the check out of the loop using the static helper
`IREE::Util::TiedOpInterface::hasAnyTiedUses(operand)` as an early exit.
Inside the loop, it now only checks whether the candidate user
implements `TiedOpInterface`. This eliminates redundant scans and
resolves the compiler performance bottleneck while preserving existing
partitioning semantics.

LLVM staging branch: `sm-iree-integrates/llvm-20260925`

Adds a cherry-pick of llvm/llvm-project#226903 to support
minimumnumf/maximumnumf semantics. The new reduction kinds were introduced in
llvm/llvm-project@8306f777. QNaN was chosen as an identity arg for the new
kinds so as to propagate signalling NaNs correctly. As per the LLVM LangRef:

> Return the other argument if one of the arguments is NaN.

(https://llvm.org/docs/LangRef.html#floating-point-min-max-intrinsics-comparison)

Additionally:
- Update compiler and end-to-end TOSA tests for the strict property assembly format (llvm/llvm-project@b9da7a34)
- Redeclare LLVM libxml2 and xz Bazel dependencies (llvm/llvm-project@bd0da2bf7dae, llvm/llvm-project@4989b3b0)

Assisted-by: Codex

Signed-off-by: Artem Gindinson <gindinson@roofline.ai>
name: ci_summary / summary

commit_message:
[spirv] Do not propagate workgroup tiling to fused ops (#24961)

Tile dispatch expects at most one op to have a workgroup tiling level,
this PR ensures this condition holds by not propagating the workgroup
tiling info to non-root ops.

This change effectively brings back the reset removed in this PR
https://github.com/iree-org/iree/pull/11975/changes#diff-33b77b320b007633f370ecfb485666dbc4a0fd8adb0f723e159c3ad32d21a760L1075

commit_message:
[spirv] Do not propagate workgroup tiling to fused ops (#24961)

Tile dispatch expects at most one op to have a workgroup tiling level,
this PR ensures this condition holds by not propagating the workgroup
tiling info to non-root ops.

This change effectively brings back the reset removed in this PR
https://github.com/iree-org/iree/pull/11975/changes#diff-33b77b320b007633f370ecfb485666dbc4a0fd8adb0f723e159c3ad32d21a760L1075

See also:

 - https://github.com/iree-org/iree/pull/18538
 - https://github.com/iree-org/iree/pull/18604

commit_message:
Integrate LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@a98f7ed68e

LLVM staging branch: `sm-iree-integrates/llvm-20260925`

Adds a cherry-pick of llvm/llvm-project#226903 to support
minimumnumf/maximumnumf semantics. The new reduction kinds were introduced in
llvm/llvm-project@8306f777. QNaN was chosen as an identity arg for the new
kinds so as to propagate signalling NaNs correctly. As per the LLVM LangRef:

> Return the other argument if one of the arguments is NaN.

(https://llvm.org/docs/LangRef.html#floating-point-min-max-intrinsics-comparison)

Additionally:
- Update compiler and end-to-end TOSA tests for the strict property assembly format (llvm/llvm-project@b9da7a34)
- Redeclare LLVM libxml2 and xz Bazel dependencies (llvm/llvm-project@bd0da2bf7dae, llvm/llvm-project@4989b3b0)

commit_message:
Integrate LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@a98f7ed68e

LLVM staging branch: `sm-iree-integrates/llvm-20260925`

Adds a cherry-pick of llvm/llvm-project#226903 to support
minimumnumf/maximumnumf semantics. The new reduction kinds were introduced in
llvm/llvm-project@8306f777. QNaN was chosen as an identity arg for the new
kinds so as to propagate signalling NaNs correctly. As per the LLVM LangRef:

> Return the other argument if one of the arguments is NaN.

(https://llvm.org/docs/LangRef.html#floating-point-min-max-intrinsics-comparison)

Additionally:
- Update compiler and end-to-end TOSA tests for the strict property assembly format (llvm/llvm-project@b9da7a34)
- Redeclare LLVM libxml2 and xz Bazel dependencies (llvm/llvm-project@bd0da2bf7dae, llvm/llvm-project@4989b3b0)

kinds so as to propagate signalling NaNs correctly. As per the LLVM LangRef:

> Return the other argument if one of the arguments is NaN.

minimumnumf/maximumnumf semantics. The new reduction kinds were introduced in
llvm/llvm-project@8306f777. QNaN was chosen as an identity arg for the new
kinds so as to propagate signalling NaNs correctly. As per the LLVM LangRef:

> Return the other argument if one of the arguments is NaN.

(https://llvm.org/docs/LangRef.html#floating-point-min-max-intrinsics-comparison)

Additionally:
- Update compiler and end-to-end TOSA tests for the strict property assembly format (llvm/llvm-project@b9da7a34)
- Redeclare LLVM libxml2 and xz Bazel dependencies (llvm/llvm-project@bd0da2bf7dae, llvm/llvm-project@4989b3b0)

commit_message:
Integrate LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@2caaa870fd90

LLVM staging branch: `sm-iree-integrates/llvm-20260925`

Adds a cherry-pick of llvm/llvm-project#226897 to support
minimumnumf/maximumnumf semantics. The new reduction kinds were introduced in
llvm/llvm-project@8306f777. QNaN was chosen as an identity arg for the new
kinds so as to propagate signalling NaNs correctly. As per the LLVM LangRef:

> Return the other argument if one of the arguments is NaN.

(https://llvm.org/docs/LangRef.html#floating-point-min-max-intrinsics-comparison)

Additionally:
- Update compiler and end-to-end TOSA tests for the strict property assembly format (llvm/llvm-project@b9da7a34)
- Redeclare LLVM libxml2 and xz Bazel dependencies (llvm/llvm-project@bd0da2bf7dae, llvm/llvm-project@4989b3b0)

commit_message:
[Build] Stop CMake riscv64 defaults from clobbering test cpu-features (#24866)

platform cmake defaults were appending
--iree-llvmcpu-target-cpu-features= after test variants, so the default
overwrote +xsmtvdot / VLEN. this prevents the override of an existing
cpu-features flag; prepend missing +m,+a,+f,+d,+c. and strips those from
generator --requirements=.
